_doc: Registry of opponent-property lever keys a Matchup Brief may assert (ADR-0027). A small, growing vocabulary (like Function Tags / Roles) — matchup-genie reuses a key where one fits and mints a new one only when nothing does, adding it here with consumer:'unwired' and flagging it. 'consumer' tracks whether the Read/Posture runtime yet maps the key onto a Board field: 'unwired' = forward contract, nothing reads it yet (the consumer is a separate, unbuilt item); a field name = the Board property it drives once wired. validate_brief.py reads this file; unknown keys in a Brief are flagged, not silently accepted.

opp_is_engine_dependent.note: the deck's setup hinges on a specific draw/search engine Pokémon; gusting + KOing it strangles the deck. Lever (future): raise disruption value against its `engine` target.

opp_donk_vulnerable.note: runs low-HP single-Basic openers; an aggressive turn-1/2 line can take an early prize lead or a donk. Lever (future): raise early aggression / prioritise the fragile_preevo snipe.

opp_tempo.note: how fast the deck comes online and starts taking prizes; sets the race clock. Lever (future): race a slow deck; stabilise-then-grind against a fast one.
